# 12. Control reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_reference.py from the control classes. Edit the
     descriptions there, not here. -->

Every control's properties, methods and events. In the event tables `Name`
stands for your control's name: a button called `cmdStart` has `cmdStart_Click(f)`.

"Read-only" properties can be read but not set. "Run time" properties can only
be set while the panel runs, never in the designer or the form file.
Properties marked read-only are still shown in the designer, greyed out.

Event procedures may take fewer arguments than listed: `def cmdGo_Click(f):`
and `def Serial1_DataArrival(f, line):` are both fine, and so is leaving off `f`.

**Every control** has **Index**, its number in a control array (chapter 6).

**All visible controls** (everything except Timer, MQTT, Serial, Modbus, SNMP, WebRequest, Data, InfluxDB and Alarms) also have
Left, Top, Width, Height, Visible, Enabled, FontName, FontSize, FontBold, Tag,
TabPage (chapter 4) and the methods SetFocus and Refresh. Label, CommandButton, TextBox, CheckBox,
OptionButton and ListBox also have BackColor and ForeColor. They are repeated in
each table so every table is complete.

## Form

The window itself. In code it is `f`; in JSON connections and MCP it is the object `Form` (or `Me`).

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| AppPath | read-only | VB's App.Path: the folder to keep your own files in (settings, logs, exports). The form's folder normally; the program's folder in a Make EXE build. |
| BackColor | read/write | Window background colour. |
| Caption | read/write | Title bar text. |
| Forms | read-only | The open forms, by name: `f.Forms["Settings"].txtValue.Text`. Read-only. |
| Height | read/write | Window height in pixels. |
| Main | read-only | The program's first form. Read-only. |
| Owner | read-only | The form that showed this one (None for the main form). Read-only. |
| Width | read/write | Window width in pixels. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Hide | Hide the window without unloading it. |
| MsgBox | `MsgBox(prompt, title=None)`: show a message and wait for OK. |
| Show | `Show("Settings", modal=False)`: open another form (Settings.json beside this one) and return it; Form_Load has run by then. `modal=True` waits until it's closed. `Show()` with no name shows this form again after Hide. |
| Unload | Close the form (fires Form_Unload first). |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Form_Load(f)` | The form finished building. Do your start-up work here. |
| `Form_Unload(f)` | The form is closing. |

## Label

Text the user can't edit: captions, readings, status lines.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Alignment | read/write | `Left`, `Center` or `Right`. |
| AutoSize | read/write | True: the label resizes to fit its Caption and font, including captions set later by code or MQTT. Width and Height then follow the text. |
| BackColor | read/write | Background colour: a name (`light yellow`) or `#rrggbb`. |
| Caption | read/write | The text shown. |
| Enabled | read/write | False greys it out and ignores the mouse and keyboard. |
| FontBold | read/write | True for bold. |
| FontName | read/write | Font family, e.g. `Helvetica`, `Arial`, `Consolas`. |
| FontSize | read/write | Font size in points. |
| ForeColor | read/write | Text colour: a name or `#rrggbb`. |
| Height | read/write | Height in pixels. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Left | read/write | Distance from the form's left edge, in pixels. |
| TabPage | read/write | Which page of a TabStrip the control is on (0, 1, 2 ...). Set for you when you draw it on a page; ignored outside a TabStrip, and saved only when it isn't 0. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Top | read/write | Distance from the form's top edge, in pixels. |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the control (it keeps its place and properties). |
| Width | read/write | Width in pixels. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Refresh | Redraw now, inside a long-running procedure. |
| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Click(f)` | The label is clicked. |
| `Name_DblClick(f)` | The label is double-clicked. |

## CommandButton

A push button.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| BackColor | read/write | Background colour: a name (`light yellow`) or `#rrggbb`. |
| Caption | read/write | The button's text. |
| Enabled | read/write | False greys it out and ignores the mouse and keyboard. |
| FontBold | read/write | True for bold. |
| FontName | read/write | Font family, e.g. `Helvetica`, `Arial`, `Consolas`. |
| FontSize | read/write | Font size in points. |
| ForeColor | read/write | Text colour: a name or `#rrggbb`. |
| Height | read/write | Height in pixels. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Left | read/write | Distance from the form's left edge, in pixels. |
| TabPage | read/write | Which page of a TabStrip the control is on (0, 1, 2 ...). Set for you when you draw it on a page; ignored outside a TabStrip, and saved only when it isn't 0. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Top | read/write | Distance from the form's top edge, in pixels. |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the control (it keeps its place and properties). |
| Width | read/write | Width in pixels. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Click | Press the button from code. Runs `Name_Click` and anything wired to it, as a real click would. Does nothing if Enabled is False. |
| Refresh | Redraw now, inside a long-running procedure. |
| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Click(f)` | The button is clicked, or `Click()` is called. |
| `Name_GotFocus(f)` | The button receives the keyboard focus. |
| `Name_LostFocus(f)` | The button loses the keyboard focus. |

## TextBox

A one-line text entry box.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| BackColor | read/write | Background colour: a name (`light yellow`) or `#rrggbb`. |
| Enabled | read/write | False greys it out and ignores the mouse and keyboard. |
| FontBold | read/write | True for bold. |
| FontName | read/write | Font family, e.g. `Helvetica`, `Arial`, `Consolas`. |
| FontSize | read/write | Font size in points. |
| ForeColor | read/write | Text colour: a name or `#rrggbb`. |
| Height | read/write | Height in pixels. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Left | read/write | Distance from the form's left edge, in pixels. |
| Locked | read/write | True: read-only, but the text can still be selected and copied. |
| PasswordChar | read/write | Show this character instead of what's typed, e.g. `*`. Empty for normal text. |
| SelText | read-only | The currently selected text. Read-only. |
| TabPage | read/write | Which page of a TabStrip the control is on (0, 1, 2 ...). Set for you when you draw it on a page; ignored outside a TabStrip, and saved only when it isn't 0. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Text | read/write | The contents. Setting it fires Change, as in VB. |
| Top | read/write | Distance from the form's top edge, in pixels. |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the control (it keeps its place and properties). |
| Width | read/write | Width in pixels. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Clear | Empty the box. |
| Refresh | Redraw now, inside a long-running procedure. |
| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Change(f)` | The text changed, by typing or by code. |
| `Name_KeyPress(f, key_ascii)` | A key that produces a character was pressed. Argument: `key_ascii`, the character code (13 is Enter). |
| `Name_GotFocus(f)` | The box receives the keyboard focus. |
| `Name_LostFocus(f)` | The box loses the keyboard focus. |

## OptionButton

A radio button. Buttons with the same Group are mutually exclusive.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| BackColor | read/write | Background colour: a name (`light yellow`) or `#rrggbb`. |
| Caption | read/write | The text beside the button. |
| Enabled | read/write | False greys it out and ignores the mouse and keyboard. |
| FontBold | read/write | True for bold. |
| FontName | read/write | Font family, e.g. `Helvetica`, `Arial`, `Consolas`. |
| FontSize | read/write | Font size in points. |
| ForeColor | read/write | Text colour: a name or `#rrggbb`. |
| Group | read/write | Group name. Buttons sharing a group act as one set. Left as `default`, buttons inside a Frame use the frame's name, so each frame is its own set. |
| Height | read/write | Height in pixels. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Left | read/write | Distance from the form's left edge, in pixels. |
| TabPage | read/write | Which page of a TabStrip the control is on (0, 1, 2 ...). Set for you when you draw it on a page; ignored outside a TabStrip, and saved only when it isn't 0. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Top | read/write | Distance from the form's top edge, in pixels. |
| Value | read/write | True when this button is the selected one in its group. Set True to select it (fires Click). |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the control (it keeps its place and properties). |
| Width | read/write | Width in pixels. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Refresh | Redraw now, inside a long-running procedure. |
| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Click(f)` | This button was selected. |

## ListBox

A scrolling list; the user picks one item.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| BackColor | read/write | Background colour: a name (`light yellow`) or `#rrggbb`. |
| Enabled | read/write | False greys it out and ignores the mouse and keyboard. |
| FontBold | read/write | True for bold. |
| FontName | read/write | Font family, e.g. `Helvetica`, `Arial`, `Consolas`. |
| FontSize | read/write | Font size in points. |
| ForeColor | read/write | Text colour: a name or `#rrggbb`. |
| Height | read/write | Height in pixels. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Left | read/write | Distance from the form's left edge, in pixels. |
| List | read/write | All items, as a list of strings. Setting it replaces them. |
| ListCount | read-only | Number of items. Read-only. |
| ListIndex | read/write | Index of the selected item (0 is the first), or -1 for none. Setting it selects and scrolls to the item and fires Click. |
| TabPage | read/write | Which page of a TabStrip the control is on (0, 1, 2 ...). Set for you when you draw it on a page; ignored outside a TabStrip, and saved only when it isn't 0. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Text | read-only | The selected item's text, or empty. Read-only. |
| Top | read/write | Distance from the form's top edge, in pixels. |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the control (it keeps its place and properties). |
| Width | read/write | Width in pixels. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| AddItem | `AddItem(item, index=None)`: add at the end, or before position `index`. |
| Clear | Remove every item. |
| Refresh | Redraw now, inside a long-running procedure. |
| RemoveItem | `RemoveItem(index)`: remove the item at that position. |
| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Click(f)` | An item was selected. |
| `Name_DblClick(f)` | An item was double-clicked. |

| Property | Access | Description |

| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

| Event procedure | Fires when |

| `Name_Change(f)` | The user typed in the box. |

## Frame

A captioned box that groups controls, like VB's Frame. Anything drawn inside its rectangle belongs to it: it moves with the frame in the designer, is hidden or disabled with it at run time, and OptionButtons inside it form their own group.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| BackColor | read/write | Background colour: a name (`light yellow`) or `#rrggbb`. |
| Caption | read/write | The title on the frame's border. |
| Enabled | read/write | False disables the frame and everything inside it (run time). |
| FontBold | read/write | True for bold. |
| FontName | read/write | Font family, e.g. `Helvetica`, `Arial`, `Consolas`. |
| FontSize | read/write | Font size in points. |
| ForeColor | read/write | Text colour: a name or `#rrggbb`. |
| Height | read/write | Height in pixels. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Left | read/write | Distance from the form's left edge, in pixels. |
| TabPage | read/write | Which page of a TabStrip the control is on (0, 1, 2 ...). Set for you when you draw it on a page; ignored outside a TabStrip, and saved only when it isn't 0. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Top | read/write | Distance from the form's top edge, in pixels. |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the frame and everything inside it (run time). |
| Width | read/write | Width in pixels. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Refresh | Redraw now, inside a long-running procedure. |
| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Click(f)` | The frame (not a control on it) is clicked. |

## TabStrip

A row of tabs over a panel, each tab a page of controls (VB's SSTab). Like a Frame, anything drawn inside its rectangle belongs to it; each control's TabPage says which page it is on, and only the current page's controls show. A Frame on a page carries its contents. OptionButtons on each page form their own group. On the phone view it is a card with tab buttons.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| BackColor | read/write | Background colour: a name (`light yellow`) or `#rrggbb`. |
| Enabled | read/write | False disables the strip and everything on it (run time). |
| FontBold | read/write | True for bold. |
| FontName | read/write | Font family, e.g. `Helvetica`, `Arial`, `Consolas`. |
| FontSize | read/write | Font size in points. |
| ForeColor | read/write | Colour of the tab captions. |
| Height | read/write | Height in pixels. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Left | read/write | Distance from the form's left edge, in pixels. |
| Tab | read/write | The page showing, counted from 0. Set it to switch pages; that doesn't fire Click. |
| TabCount | read-only | How many tabs there are. Read-only. |
| TabPage | read/write | Which page of a TabStrip the control is on (0, 1, 2 ...). Set for you when you draw it on a page; ignored outside a TabStrip, and saved only when it isn't 0. |
| Tabs | read/write | The tab captions, one per line (one per page). |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Top | read/write | Distance from the form's top edge, in pixels. |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the strip and everything on it (run time). |
| Width | read/write | Width in pixels. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Refresh | Redraw now, inside a long-running procedure. |
| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Click(f, previous_tab)` | The user picked another tab; Tab is already the new page and previous_tab is the one before. |

## ProgressBar

A horizontal bar showing a value from 0 to Max. Good for tank levels and progress.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Enabled | read/write | Always True. |
| FontBold | read/write | True for bold. |
| FontName | read/write | Font family, e.g. `Helvetica`, `Arial`, `Consolas`. |
| FontSize | read/write | Font size in points. |
| Height | read/write | Height in pixels. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Left | read/write | Distance from the form's left edge, in pixels. |
| Max | read/write | The value that fills the bar. Default 100. |
| TabPage | read/write | Which page of a TabStrip the control is on (0, 1, 2 ...). Set for you when you draw it on a page; ignored outside a TabStrip, and saved only when it isn't 0. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Top | read/write | Distance from the form's top edge, in pixels. |
| Value | read/write | The current value, 0 to Max. Values outside the range are clamped. |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the control (it keeps its place and properties). |
| Width | read/write | Width in pixels. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Refresh | Redraw now, inside a long-running procedure. |
| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

## Slider

Drag to set a value, like VB's Slider: a setpoint, a speed, a dimmer. Value is a whole number unless SmallChange is a fraction.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| BackColor | read/write | Background colour: a name (`light yellow`) or `#rrggbb`. |
| Enabled | read/write | False greys it out and ignores the mouse and keyboard. |
| FontBold | read/write | True for bold. |
| FontName | read/write | Font family, e.g. `Helvetica`, `Arial`, `Consolas`. |
| FontSize | read/write | Font size in points. |
| ForeColor | read/write | Text colour: a name or `#rrggbb`. |
| Height | read/write | Height in pixels. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| LargeChange | read/write | How far a click in the trough moves it (0 = SmallChange). |
| Left | read/write | Distance from the form's left edge, in pixels. |
| Max | read/write | The value at the right (or bottom). |
| Min | read/write | The value at the left (or top). |
| Orientation | read/write | Horizontal or Vertical. |
| ShowValue | read/write | Show the value above the handle. |
| SmallChange | read/write | The step: 1 for whole numbers, 0.5 for halves. Arrow keys move by this much. |
| TabPage | read/write | Which page of a TabStrip the control is on (0, 1, 2 ...). Set for you when you draw it on a page; ignored outside a TabStrip, and saved only when it isn't 0. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| TickFrequency | read/write | Numbers along the scale every this many units (0 = none). |
| Top | read/write | Distance from the form's top edge, in pixels. |
| Value | read/write | The current value, Min to Max. Setting it fires Change. |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the control (it keeps its place and properties). |
| Width | read/write | Width in pixels. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Refresh | Redraw now, inside a long-running procedure. |
| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Change(f)` | Value changed: the user let go of the handle, used the arrow keys, or code set Value. |
| `Name_Scroll(f)` | The handle is being dragged (fires continuously). Good for a live readout. |

## Gauge

A ready-made dial: set Value and the needle moves. Coloured Zones mark warning and alarm ranges. With Interactive on, the needle can be dragged, so it's also a knob.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| BackColor | read/write | Background colour. |
| Decimals | read/write | Decimal places for the value (-1 = automatic). |
| Enabled | read/write | False greys it out and ignores the mouse and keyboard. |
| FontBold | read/write | True for bold. |
| FontName | read/write | Font family, e.g. `Helvetica`, `Arial`, `Consolas`. |
| FontSize | read/write | Font size in points. |
| ForeColor | read/write | Colour of the numbers, ticks and text. |
| Height | read/write | Height in pixels. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Interactive | read/write | True: drag the needle to set Value (a knob). Also works by tapping in the phone view. |
| Left | read/write | Distance from the form's left edge, in pixels. |
| MajorTicks | read/write | How many numbered divisions round the scale (default 5). |
| Max | read/write | The value at the end of the scale (bottom right). |
| Min | read/write | The value at the start of the scale (bottom left). |
| NeedleColor | read/write | Colour of the needle. |
| TabPage | read/write | Which page of a TabStrip the control is on (0, 1, 2 ...). Set for you when you draw it on a page; ignored outside a TabStrip, and saved only when it isn't 0. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Title | read/write | Shown under the value. |
| Top | read/write | Distance from the form's top edge, in pixels. |
| Units | read/write | Shown after the value, e.g. `psi` or `°C`. |
| Value | read/write | The reading. Values outside Min..Max pin the needle at the end but are kept. |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the control (it keeps its place and properties). |
| Width | read/write | Width in pixels. |
| Zones | read/write | Coloured ranges, one per line: `from to colour`, e.g. `80 90 gold` and `90 100 red`. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Refresh | Redraw now, inside a long-running procedure. |
| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Change(f)` | Interactive only: the user let go after turning it. |
| `Name_Scroll(f)` | Interactive only: the needle is being dragged. |
| `Name_Click(f)` | The gauge is clicked. |

## SegmentDisplay

A seven-segment readout, like a scale head, meter or clock: LED (lit segments on black), LCD (black segments on a grey panel) or LCD Reverse. Drawn as shapes, so it needs no special font and looks the same on the phone.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Alignment | read/write | Right (the usual for numbers), Left or Center. |
| BackColor | read/write | Background colour of the panel. |
| Decimals | read/write | Places after the point for numbers; -1 = as many as fit. |
| Digits | read/write | How many digit positions (1 to 32). The decimal point doesn't take one. A value that doesn't fit shows dashes, never a wrong number. |
| Enabled | read/write | False greys it out and ignores the mouse and keyboard. |
| FontBold | read/write | True for bold. |
| FontName | read/write | Font family, e.g. `Helvetica`, `Arial`, `Consolas`. |
| FontSize | read/write | Font size in points. |
| Height | read/write | Height in pixels. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| LeadingZeros | read/write | True: pad numbers with zeros (`000042`). |
| Left | read/write | Distance from the form's left edge, in pixels. |
| OffColor | read/write | Colour of the unlit segments (the faint 'ghosts'). Empty = a dark shade of OnColor. |
| OnColor | read/write | Colour of the lit segments. |
| ShowOff | read/write | True: draw the unlit segments faintly, as real displays show them. |
| Slant | read/write | Lean of the digits in degrees, 0 to 15 (default 6). |
| Style | read/write | LED, LCD or LCD Reverse. Choosing one sets OnColor, OffColor and BackColor; change those afterwards for your own colours. |
| TabPage | read/write | Which page of a TabStrip the control is on (0, 1, 2 ...). Set for you when you draw it on a page; ignored outside a TabStrip, and saved only when it isn't 0. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Text | read-only | What the display shows now, position by position (spaces for blanks). Read-only. |
| Top | read/write | Distance from the form's top edge, in pixels. |
| Value | read/write | What to show: a number (numeric text such as `"61240"` from a device counts), or short text like `Err`, `OL`, `-OL-`. Letters a seven-segment display can't form are blank. |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the control (it keeps its place and properties). |
| Width | read/write | Width in pixels. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Refresh | Redraw now, inside a long-running procedure. |
| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Click(f)` | The display was clicked (or tapped on the phone). |

## PictureBox

A picture and a drawing surface, as in VB. Show a PNG/GIF (JPEG with Pillow) with Picture, and draw lines, circles, arcs, shapes and text on it from code: gauges, dials, tank and pipe diagrams, anything the stock controls don't cover. Drawings are run-time output, never saved in the form; Cls clears them.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| AutoSize | read/write | True: the box resizes to fit its Picture. |
| BackColor | read/write | Background colour. Default white. |
| BorderStyle | read/write | 1: a thin border (default). 0: none. |
| CurrentX | run time | Where the next Print or LineTo starts, in your units. Set by every drawing method. |
| CurrentY | run time | Where the next Print or LineTo starts, in your units. Print moves it down a line. |
| DrawCount | read-only | How many drawings the box holds. Read-only. |
| DrawWidth | read/write | Line thickness in pixels, and the size of a PSet point. Default 1. |
| Enabled | read/write | False greys it out and ignores the mouse and keyboard. |
| FillColor | read/write | Default fill for boxes, circles and polygons. Empty (the default): not filled. |
| FontBold | read/write | True for bold. |
| FontName | read/write | Font family, e.g. `Helvetica`, `Arial`, `Consolas`. |
| FontSize | read/write | Font size in points. |
| ForeColor | read/write | Default colour for Line, Circle, PSet, Polygon and Print when you don't give one. |
| Height | read/write | Height in pixels. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Left | read/write | Distance from the form's left edge, in pixels. |
| Picture | read/write | Picture file shown behind the drawing, relative to the form's folder (`gauges/logo.png`). PNG and GIF always work; JPEG needs Pillow (`pip install pillow`). |
| ScaleHeight | read/write | Your units down the box. 0: pixels. Negative makes y point up (ScaleTop 100, ScaleHeight -200: y from 100 at the top to -100 at the bottom), handy for gauges and graphs. |
| ScaleLeft | read/write | x at the left edge, when ScaleWidth is set. |
| ScaleTop | read/write | y at the top edge, when ScaleHeight is set. |
| ScaleWidth | read/write | Your units across the box. 0 (the default): pixels. Example: ScaleLeft -100, ScaleWidth 200 puts x = 0 in the middle. |
| Stretch | read/write | True: the Picture is scaled to fill the box (smoothly with Pillow, roughly without). |
| TabPage | read/write | Which page of a TabStrip the control is on (0, 1, 2 ...). Set for you when you draw it on a page; ignored outside a TabStrip, and saved only when it isn't 0. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Top | read/write | Distance from the form's top edge, in pixels. |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the control (it keeps its place and properties). |
| Width | read/write | Width in pixels. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Circle | `Circle(x, y, radius, color=None, start=None, end=None, fill=None, aspect=1.0, width=None)`: a circle. `start`/`end` in degrees (0 = 3 o'clock, counter-clockwise) draw an arc, or a pie slice when filled; `aspect` below 1 squashes it into an ellipse. The radius is in x units. |
| Cls | `Cls()`: clear the drawings (the Picture stays) and move CurrentX/CurrentY to the top-left. |
| Line | `Line(x1, y1, x2, y2, color=None, box=False, fill=None, width=None)`: a line; `box=True` draws a rectangle, and `fill` a colour (or True for the line colour) fills it, like VB's `B` and `BF`. |
| LineTo | `LineTo(x, y, color=None)`: a line from CurrentX, CurrentY (VB's `Line -(x, y)`). Good for plotting. |
| PSet | `PSet(x, y, color=None)`: one point, DrawWidth pixels across. |
| PaintPicture | `PaintPicture(path, x=0, y=0, width=None, height=None)`: draw a picture file at (x, y), optionally scaled to width x height in your units. |
| Polygon | `Polygon(points, color=None, fill=None, width=None)`: a closed shape through `[(x, y), ...]`: a needle, an arrow, a tank. |
| Print | `Print(text, x=None, y=None, color=None, anchor="nw")`: text at (x, y), or at CurrentX/CurrentY, which then moves down a line. `anchor` says which part of the text sits at (x, y): `nw` (top-left), `center`, `n`, `e`, `s`, `w`, `ne`, `se`, `sw`. Uses the box's font. |
| Refresh | Redraw everything. |
| Scale | `Scale(x1, y1, x2, y2)`: set ScaleLeft/Top/Width/Height in one go, from the top-left and bottom-right corners. `Scale()` goes back to pixels. |
| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Click(f, x, y)` | The box is clicked; x and y are where, in its Scale units. Also from a tap in the phone view. |
| `Name_DblClick(f, x, y)` | The box is double-clicked, at x, y. |
| `Name_MouseDown(f, x, y)` | The mouse button goes down over the box, at x, y. |
| `Name_MouseUp(f, x, y)` | The mouse button comes up, at x, y. |
| `Name_MouseMove(f, x, y)` | The mouse moves with the button held (a drag), at x, y. Use it for knobs and sliders you draw yourself. |

## Chart

A scrolling trend chart of up to four lines. Setting Value (or Value2..Value4) adds a timestamped point, so a Chart can follow an MQTT topic or a Serial Fill with no code.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| AutoScale | read/write | True: the Y axis fits the data shown. False: fixed at YMin..YMax. |
| BackColor | read/write | Background colour: a name (`light yellow`) or `#rrggbb`. |
| Colors | read/write | Line colours, one per line. Default blue, red, green, orange. |
| Count | read-only | Points held for the first line. Read-only. |
| Decimals | read/write | Decimal places for the latest values (-1 = as received). |
| Enabled | read/write | Always True. |
| FontBold | read/write | True for bold. |
| FontName | read/write | Font family, e.g. `Helvetica`, `Arial`, `Consolas`. |
| FontSize | read/write | Font size in points. |
| ForeColor | read/write | Colour of the title and axis text. |
| GridLines | read/write | Horizontal grid lines. |
| Height | read/write | Height in pixels. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Left | read/write | Distance from the form's left edge, in pixels. |
| LineWidth | read/write | Line thickness in pixels. |
| Series | read/write | Line names, one per line in the designer (also the legend). Default `Value`. |
| TabPage | read/write | Which page of a TabStrip the control is on (0, 1, 2 ...). Set for you when you draw it on a page; ignored outside a TabStrip, and saved only when it isn't 0. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Title | read/write | Text at the top left. |
| Top | read/write | Distance from the form's top edge, in pixels. |
| Units | read/write | Shown after axis numbers and the latest values, e.g. `%` or `°C`. |
| Value | run time | Set it to add a point to the first line (run time). Reads back the latest value. |
| Value2 | run time | Add a point to the second line. |
| Value3 | run time | Add a point to the third line. |
| Value4 | run time | Add a point to the fourth line. |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the control (it keeps its place and properties). |
| Width | read/write | Width in pixels. |
| Window | read/write | Seconds shown, e.g. 300 (5 minutes) or 3600 (an hour). Older points scroll off. |
| YMax | read/write | Top of the Y axis when AutoScale is False. |
| YMin | read/write | Bottom of the Y axis when AutoScale is False. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| AddPoint | `AddPoint(value, series=0)`: add a point; series is a number (0 = first) or a name from Series. |
| Clear | Remove all points. |
| Refresh | Redraw now, inside a long-running procedure. |
| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Click(f)` | The chart is clicked. |

## Grid

A table of rows and columns (VB's DBGrid). Set DataSource to a Data control to show its records, refreshed after every Log; or fill it from code.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Columns | read/write | Column headings, one per line. Set automatically when bound to a Data control. |
| DataSource | read/write | Name of a Data control whose RecordSource this grid shows. Empty: fill it yourself. |
| Enabled | read/write | Always True. |
| FontBold | read/write | True for bold. |
| FontName | read/write | Font family, e.g. `Helvetica`, `Arial`, `Consolas`. |
| FontSize | read/write | Font size in points. |
| Height | read/write | Height in pixels. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Left | read/write | Distance from the form's left edge, in pixels. |
| Row | read/write | Index of the selected row (0 = first), or -1. Setting it selects and scrolls to that row. |
| RowCount | read-only | Number of rows. Read-only. |
| Rows | read/write | All rows, as a list of lists. Setting it replaces them. |
| TabPage | read/write | Which page of a TabStrip the control is on (0, 1, 2 ...). Set for you when you draw it on a page; ignored outside a TabStrip, and saved only when it isn't 0. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Text | read-only | The selected row's values separated by tabs. Read-only. |
| Top | read/write | Distance from the form's top edge, in pixels. |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the control (it keeps its place and properties). |
| Width | read/write | Width in pixels. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| AddRow | `AddRow(v1, v2, ...)` or `AddRow([v1, v2])`: add a row at the end. |
| Cell | `Cell(row, column)`: one value; column is a number or a heading. |
| Clear | Remove every row. |
| Refresh | Re-run the bound Data control's RecordSource. |
| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Click(f)` | A row was selected. |
| `Name_DblClick(f)` | A row was double-clicked. |

## Timer

Invisible. Fires its Timer event every Interval milliseconds while Enabled.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Enabled | read/write | True runs the timer. Default False, so set it in the designer or Form_Load. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Interval | read/write | Milliseconds between ticks. 0 stops it. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Timer(f)` | The interval elapsed. |

## MQTT

Invisible MQTT client for code: subscribe in Form_Load or the Subscriptions property, react in MessageArrived. See chapter 8.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| AutoConnect | read/write | Connect when the form loads. Default True. |
| Broker | read/write | Broker host name. `${VAR}` reads an environment variable. |
| CAFile | read/write | CA certificate file for private or self-signed brokers. Empty uses the system's trusted roots. |
| ClientID | read/write | MQTT client id. Empty picks a random one. |
| Connected | read-only | True while connected. Read-only. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| LastError | read-only | The last connection error, or empty. Read-only. |
| Password | read/write | Broker password. Use `${VAR}` to keep it out of the file. |
| Port | read/write | Broker port. 0 means 1883 (8883 with TLS). `${VAR:-8883}` allowed. |
| Subscriptions | read/write | Topic filters to subscribe to (one per line in the designer). Re-subscribed after every reconnect. |
| TLS | read/write | True for an encrypted connection. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Username | read/write | Broker login. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Connect | Connect (and keep reconnecting). |
| Disconnect | Disconnect and stop reconnecting. |
| Publish | `Publish(topic, payload, retain=False, qos=0)`. |
| Subscribe | `Subscribe(topic, qos=0)`. Wildcards `+` and `#` allowed. |
| Unsubscribe | `Unsubscribe(topic)`. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_MessageArrived(f, topic, payload, retained)` | A message arrived. Arguments: `topic, payload, retained`. |
| `Name_Connected(f)` | Connected (or reconnected) to the broker. |
| `Name_Disconnected(f)` | Lost the broker. It keeps retrying. |
| `Name_Error(f, message)` | Connection error. Argument: `message`. Reported once per problem, not every retry. |

## Serial

Invisible serial port (VB's MSComm, improved). See chapter 9.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| AutoOpen | read/write | Open the port when the form loads. Default True. |
| AutoReconnect | read/write | Reopen by itself after an unplug, or keep trying until the device appears. Default True. |
| DTR | read/write | Data Terminal Ready line. Many Arduinos reset when it rises on open; set False to avoid the reset. Left low on ESP32 native USB unless set here. |
| DeviceName | read-only | The device actually opened (useful with `auto`). Read-only. |
| Encoding | read/write | Text encoding. Default `utf-8`; `latin-1` for raw 8-bit data. |
| Fill | read/write | Lines like `temp -> lblTemp.Caption`. Fields of incoming JSON lines (or `key=value` lines) are copied to those properties. |
| InBufferCount | read-only | Characters waiting in Input. Read-only. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Input | read-only | Everything received since Input was last read; reading clears it. Read-only. |
| LastError | read-only | The last error, or empty. Read-only. |
| Line | read-only | The last complete line received. Read-only. |
| Output | run time | Set it to send text plus the Terminator (run time only). Reads back empty. |
| Port | read/write | `COM3`, `/dev/ttyUSB0`, `auto` (the one USB serial device; refuses if several), `auto:CH340` (the one port whose name contains the text), or a URL: `socket://host:port`, `rfc2217://host:port`, `loop://`. |
| PortOpen | run time | True while open. Set True/False to open or close (run time only). |
| RTS | read/write | Request To Send line. Left low on ESP32 native USB unless set here. |
| Settings | read/write | `baud,parity,databits,stopbits`, e.g. `9600,n,8,1` or `115200,n,8,1`. Can be changed while open. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Terminator | read/write | Line ending: `LF` (default; also accepts CR+LF), `CR`, `CRLF`, or `None` for raw chunks. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| ClearInput | Empty the Input buffer. |
| Close | Close the port and stop retrying. |
| ListPorts | The serial ports on this computer, as a list of `COM3 - description`. |
| Open | Open the port (keeps trying in the background with AutoReconnect). |
| SendLine | `SendLine(text)`: send text plus the Terminator. Same as setting Output. |
| Write | `Write(text)`: send exactly this text, no line ending added. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_DataArrival(f, line)` | A complete line arrived. Argument: `line` (without the line ending). |
| `Name_Connected(f)` | The port opened. |
| `Name_Disconnected(f)` | The port closed or the device was unplugged. |
| `Name_Error(f, message)` | A problem opening or reading. Argument: `message`. |

## Modbus

A Modbus TCP or RTU master: poll registers and coils into named values, write them from code. For PLCs, VFDs, energy meters, charge controllers. Needs `pip install pymodbus`.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| AutoOpen | read/write | True: start polling when the form opens. False: call Open yourself. |
| ByteOrder | read/write | How 32/64-bit values are stored: ABCD (standard), CDAB (word swap, common on meters), BADC or DCBA. A Poll line can override it. |
| Connected | run time | True while the device answers. Set False/True to close/open. |
| Fill | read/write | Values to put into properties with no code, one per line: `name -> Control.Property`, e.g. `volts -> gauVolts.Value`. |
| Host | read/write | TCP: the device's IP address or name. `${METER_HOST}` reads an environment variable. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| LastError | read-only | The last problem, or empty. Read-only. |
| Mode | read/write | TCP (Ethernet) or RTU (serial, RS-485). |
| Poll | read/write | What to read, one per line: `name = what [*scale] [/divisor] [+offset]`. Each poll fires DataArrival with a dict of these names. |
| PollInterval | read/write | Milliseconds between polls (0 = only when you call PollNow). |
| Port | read/write | TCP port, usually 502. |
| SerialPort | read/write | RTU: the serial port (COM3, /dev/ttyUSB0, or `auto`). |
| Settings | read/write | RTU: baud,parity,data,stop, e.g. `9600,n,8,1` or `19200,e,8,1`. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Target | read-only | The address in use, with ${VARIABLES} filled in. Read-only. |
| Timeout | read/write | Seconds to wait for an answer. |
| UnitID | read/write | The device's unit (slave) id, usually 1. |
| Values | read-only | The last polled values, as a dict. Read-only. |
| ValuesJson | read-only | Values as JSON text (what MQTT publish sends). Read-only. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Close | Stop polling and disconnect. |
| Get | `Get(name)`: the last polled value of a Poll name. |
| Open | Start polling (and reconnecting) in the background. |
| PollNow | Read the Poll list now instead of waiting for the next interval. |
| Read | `Read(what)`: one value now, e.g. `Read("hr 100 f32")` or `Read("40101 *0.1")`. |
| Write | `Write(what, value)`: a coil (`"co 3"`, True) or holding register(s) (`"hr 10 f32"`, 21.5). Scaling in what is undone: `Write("hr 10 *0.1", 23.5)` sends 235. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_DataArrival(f, values)` | A poll finished; values is a dict of the Poll names, scaled. |
| `Name_Connected(f)` | The device answered (after starting or reconnecting). |
| `Name_Disconnected(f)` | The device stopped answering. It keeps retrying. |
| `Name_Error(f, message)` | Something failed: message says what (a bad address, a timeout, a refused write). |

## SNMP

An SNMP manager: poll OIDs from UPSes, PDUs, switches and servers, Get/Walk/Set in code, and receive traps. Needs `pip install pysnmp`.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| AuthKey | read/write | SNMPv3 authentication passphrase (empty = no authentication). |
| AuthProtocol | read/write | SNMPv3: MD5, SHA, SHA224, SHA256, SHA384 or SHA512. |
| AutoOpen | read/write | True: start polling when the form opens. False: call Open yourself. |
| Community | read/write | Read community (v1/v2c), usually `public`. Use `${VARIABLE}` to keep it out of the file. |
| Connected | run time | True while the device answers. Set False/True to close/open. |
| Fill | read/write | Values to put into properties with no code, one per line: `name -> Control.Property`, e.g. `volts -> gauVolts.Value`. |
| Host | read/write | The device's IP address or name. `${UPS_HOST}` reads an environment variable. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| LastError | read-only | The last problem, or empty. Read-only. |
| Poll | read/write | What to read, one per line: `name = what [*scale] [/divisor] [+offset]`. Each poll fires DataArrival with a dict of these names. |
| PollInterval | read/write | Milliseconds between polls (0 = only when you call PollNow). |
| Port | read/write | UDP port, usually 161. |
| PrivKey | read/write | SNMPv3 privacy (encryption) passphrase (empty = none). |
| PrivProtocol | read/write | SNMPv3: DES, 3DES, AES, AES192 or AES256. |
| Retries | read/write | How many times to resend before giving up. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Target | read-only | The address in use, with ${VARIABLES} filled in. Read-only. |
| Timeout | read/write | Seconds to wait for an answer. |
| TrapCommunity | read/write | Community traps must use (v1/v2c). |
| TrapPort | read/write | UDP port to listen for traps on (0 = don't). 162 is standard but needs admin rights; 1162 doesn't. |
| User | read/write | SNMPv3 user name. |
| Values | read-only | The last polled values, as a dict. Read-only. |
| ValuesJson | read-only | Values as JSON text (what MQTT publish sends). Read-only. |
| Version | read/write | 1, 2c (default) or 3. |
| WriteCommunity | read/write | Community for Set (v1/v2c), often `private`. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Close | Stop polling and disconnect. |
| Get | `Get(what)`: one value now: a Poll name, an OID or a known name like `sysDescr`, with optional `*scale`. |
| Open | Start polling (and reconnecting) in the background. |
| PollNow | Read the Poll list now instead of waiting for the next interval. |
| Set | `Set(what, value, type)`: write one OID. type is snmpset's letter: i, u, g, c, t, s, a, o (default i for numbers, s for text). |
| Walk | `Walk(what)`: everything under a subtree, as a dict, e.g. `Walk("ifDescr")`. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_DataArrival(f, values)` | A poll finished; values is a dict of the Poll names, scaled. |
| `Name_Connected(f)` | The device answered (after starting or reconnecting). |
| `Name_Disconnected(f)` | The device stopped answering. It keeps retrying. |
| `Name_Error(f, message)` | Something failed: message says what (a bad address, a timeout, a refused write). |
| `Name_Trap(f, source, values)` | A trap arrived: source is the sender's IP, values a dict of its contents with readable names where known. |

## WebRequest

Invisible: reads a web API (JSON) every PollInterval ms, like VB's Inet control. Poll lines are paths into the reply; Fill puts values on controls. See chapter 19.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| AutoOpen | read/write | Start reading when the panel starts (default True). |
| Body | read/write | Text sent with POST or PUT (sent as JSON when it starts with `{` or `[`); `${VAR}` works. |
| Connected | run time | True while replies keep coming. Read-only. |
| Fill | read/write | `name -> Control.Property`, one per line, as on Serial and Modbus. With no Poll lines, full paths work (`current.temperature_2m -> segTemp.Value`). |
| Headers | read/write | One `Name: value` per line, e.g. `Authorization: Bearer ${HA_TOKEN}`. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| LastError | read-only | The last problem, or empty. Read-only. |
| LastUpdate | read-only | When the last good reply arrived. Read-only. |
| Method | read/write | GET (the usual), POST or PUT. |
| Poll | read/write | One value per line: `name = path`, e.g. `temp = current.temperature_2m`, `desc = weather[0].description`, with optional scaling (`*0.02953`). No lines: DataArrival gets the whole reply. |
| PollInterval | read/write | Milliseconds between requests (default 60000). 0 = only when PollNow is called. After a failure it waits 5 to 60 s. |
| Response | read-only | The raw text of the last reply, for finding paths. Read-only. |
| StatusCode | read-only | The HTTP status of the last reply (200 = fine). Read-only. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Target | read-only | Host and path in use (no query string). Read-only. |
| Timeout | read/write | Seconds to wait for a reply (1 to 300, default 15). |
| URL | read/write | The address. `${VAR}` fills in keys from the environment. Messages and Target never show the part after `?`. |
| Values | read-only | The latest values, by Poll name. Read-only. |
| ValuesJson | read-only | Values as JSON (what MQTT publish sends). Read-only. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Close | Stop reading. |
| Fetch | Ask once and return the reply (JSON as dicts and lists, or text). It waits for it, so use it for occasional button presses. |
| Get | The latest value of one Poll name. |
| Open | Start reading (if AutoOpen is False). |
| PollNow | Ask now instead of waiting for PollInterval. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_DataArrival(f, values)` | A reply arrived: values (by Poll name, or the whole reply with no Poll lines). |
| `Name_Connected(f)` | The first good reply after starting or after a failure. |
| `Name_Disconnected(f)` | Replies stopped (no internet, an HTTP error). |
| `Name_Error(f, message)` | Something went wrong: message says what (HTTP status and a hint, a missing path...). |

## Data

Invisible SQLite database beside the form (VB's Data control), with no-code logging. See chapter 6, *Logging to a database*.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Columns | read-only | Column names from the last RecordSource query. Read-only. |
| DatabaseName | read/write | The database file. Empty: `<form name>.db` next to the form. A relative name is relative to the form's folder. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| LastError | read-only | The last error, or empty. Read-only. |
| LogEvery | read/write | Seconds between automatic rows (0 = only when Log() is called). |
| LogFields | read/write | What a logged row holds, one per line: `column = Object.Property`, e.g. `level = barLevel.Value`. Columns are created automatically. |
| Path | read-only | Full path of the database file. Read-only. |
| RecordCount | read-only | Rows in Table. Read-only. |
| RecordSource | read/write | The SELECT a bound Grid shows. Default: the newest 100 rows of Table. |
| Table | read/write | Table to log to and read from. Default `log`. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| AddColumns | `AddColumns("plate", "gross", ...)`: make sure these columns exist (added if missing). Handy in Form_Load before the first Log. |
| Clear | Delete every row of Table. No confirmation: ask the user first. |
| Execute | `Execute(sql, params=None)`: run any SQL (UPDATE, DELETE...); returns rows changed. |
| ExportCSV | `ExportCSV(path=None, sql=None)`: write the records to a CSV file (opens in Excel); returns the path. |
| Log | `Log()` logs the LogFields now; `Log({"weight": 1234, "ticket": "A17"})` logs your own values (new columns are added). Returns the row. |
| Query | `Query(sql=None, params=None)`: run a SELECT, get a list of dicts. `?` placeholders with params. |
| Refresh | Re-run RecordSource and update bound Grids. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Logged(f, row)` | A row was logged. Argument: `row`, a dict including id and time. |
| `Name_Error(f, message)` | Opening or logging failed. Argument: `message`. |

## InfluxDB

Invisible: logs panel values to InfluxDB 2.x for Grafana, with no code. LogFields say what a point holds, LogEvery how often; points are written in batches on a background thread and kept in memory while the server is away. See chapter 20.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Bucket | read/write | The bucket, default `${INFLUX_BUCKET:-panelworks}`. |
| Connected | run time | True after a write succeeds, False after one fails. Read-only. (Events: Connected, Disconnected.) |
| Dropped | run time | Points thrown away because MaxBuffer was full. Read-only. |
| FlushEvery | read/write | Seconds between writes (0.5 to 3600, default 5). Points wait in memory until then. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| LastError | run time | The last problem, or empty. Read-only. |
| LastWrite | run time | When points were last written. Read-only. |
| LogEvery | read/write | Seconds between automatic points; 0 = only when code calls Log. |
| LogFields | read/write | `field = Control.Property`, one per line, as on the Data control: `level = barLevel.Value`. |
| MaxBuffer | read/write | Points kept while InfluxDB can't be reached (default 10000); the oldest go first. |
| Measurement | read/write | The measurement name (default: the form's name). |
| Org | read/write | The organization, default `${INFLUX_ORG}`. |
| Pending | run time | Points waiting to be written. Read-only. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Tags | read/write | `name = value`, one per line, added to every point (`site = barn`, `host = ${COMPUTERNAME}`). |
| Token | read/write | An API token that can write to the bucket, default `${INFLUX_TOKEN}`. Keep it in the environment, not the form file. |
| URL | read/write | The server, default `${INFLUX_URL:-http://localhost:8086}`. |
| Written | run time | Points written since the panel started. Read-only. (Event: Written(count) after each write.) |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Flush | Write what's waiting now, and wait. True if it all went. |
| Log | Queue a point: `Log()` logs the LogFields; `Log({"amps": 12.5})` your own fields; `Log(values, measurement="pump", tags={"unit": "2"})` another series. Returns the line protocol. |
| Ping | True if the server answers. |
| Query | Run a Flux query; returns a list of dicts (`_time`, `_value`, `_field` ...). It waits, so use it from a button, not a timer. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Written(f, count)` | Points written since the panel started. Read-only. (Event: Written(count) after each write.) |
| `Name_Error(f, message)` | A write failed (once, until one works again), or Log got bad values. |
| `Name_Connected(f)` | True after a write succeeds, False after one fails. Read-only. (Events: Connected, Disconnected.) |
| `Name_Disconnected(f)` | Writes started failing; points wait in memory and are retried. |

## Alarms

Invisible alarm manager: limits on any value, with delay, deadband, priorities, acknowledge and history (the basics of ISA-18.2). See chapter 18.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Active | read-only | Names of the alarms whose condition holds now. Read-only. |
| Count | read-only | How many alarms are listed. Read-only. |
| Enabled | read/write | False stops the checks (alarms already listed stay). |
| Entries | read-only | The alarm list (active or not yet acknowledged), most important first: a list of dicts with name, state, priority, message, value, since. Read-only. |
| HighestPriority | read-only | The most important priority listed: 1, 2, 3, or 0 for none. Read-only. |
| History | read-only | What happened, newest first: `time  ALARM|CLEAR|ACK  name  message (value)`. Read-only. |
| HistoryMax | read/write | How many History lines to keep (default 200). |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Interval | read/write | Milliseconds between checks of every rule (0 = only when you call Check). |
| LastError | read-only | The last problem (a rule naming a missing control, a Telegram failure), or empty. Read-only. |
| LastJson | read-only | The last change as JSON: name, state, message, value, priority, time. This is what MQTT publish sends. Read-only. |
| LogTo | read/write | Name of a Data control: every alarm, clear and acknowledge is logged there as a row. |
| NotifyPriority | read/write | Which alarms notify Telegram: 1 = critical only, 2 = critical and high, 3 = all (default). |
| Rules | read/write | One alarm per line: `Name: source test limit [delay=s] [deadband=x] [priority=1..3] [message=text]`, e.g. `HighVolts: mb1.volts > 250 delay=5 message=Voltage high`. Source is `Control.Property` or a polling control's value (`mb1.volts`). |
| Summary | read-only | `No alarms` or e.g. `2 alarms, 1 unacknowledged`. Read-only. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| TelegramChat | read/write | The Telegram chat id to send to. |
| TelegramToken | read/write | A Telegram bot token, to message alarms and clears straight to Telegram. Use `${TELEGRAM_TOKEN}` to keep it out of the form file. |
| Unacked | read-only | How many alarms are waiting to be acknowledged. Read-only. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Ack | Acknowledge an alarm by name, or all of them with `Ack()`. |
| Check | Check every rule now. |
| ClearHistory | Empty the History list. |
| State | An alarm's state: Normal, Pending (waiting out its delay), Active, Acked or Cleared. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Alarm(f, name, message, value)` | An alarm's condition held (for its delay): it is now active and unacknowledged. |
| `Name_Clear(f, name, value)` | An active alarm's condition cleared (past its deadband). |
| `Name_Ack(f, name)` | An alarm was acknowledged (panel click, phone tap or Ack). |
| `Name_Change(f)` | The alarm list changed: something alarmed, cleared or was acknowledged. |

## AlarmPanel

The alarm list of an Alarms control: priority colour, time, name, message and value. Unacknowledged alarms flash; click one to acknowledge it, or the header to acknowledge them all. Also on the phone view, where a tap acknowledges.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| BackColor | read/write | Background colour. |
| Enabled | read/write | False greys it out and ignores the mouse and keyboard. |
| FontBold | read/write | True for bold. |
| FontName | read/write | Font family, e.g. `Helvetica`, `Arial`, `Consolas`. |
| FontSize | read/write | Font size in points. |
| ForeColor | read/write | Colour of the header text. |
| Height | read/write | Height in pixels. |
| Index | read-only | Its number in a control array (`Lamp(3)` has Index 3), or empty if it isn't in one. In the designer, set it to make an array (chapter 6). In code it's read-only. |
| Left | read/write | Distance from the form's left edge, in pixels. |
| Source | read/write | The Alarms control to show. Empty = the form's only (or first) one. |
| TabPage | read/write | Which page of a TabStrip the control is on (0, 1, 2 ...). Set for you when you draw it on a page; ignored outside a TabStrip, and saved only when it isn't 0. |
| Tag | read/write | Free text for your own use. PanelWorks never reads it. |
| Title | read/write | Text at the start of the header, before the summary. |
| Top | read/write | Distance from the form's top edge, in pixels. |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the control (it keeps its place and properties). |
| Width | read/write | Width in pixels. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Refresh | Redraw now, inside a long-running procedure. |
| SetFocus | Move the keyboard focus to this control. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Click(f, name)` | A row (name = that alarm) or the header (name = "") was clicked; the alarm(s) are acknowledged first. |

## Menu items

Built with the designer's **Menu Editor** (Tools → Menu Editor, Ctrl+E). Each
item is an object named in the editor, e.g. `mnuFileExit`.

**Properties**

| Property | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Caption | read/write | The text. `&` before a letter underlines it as the access key; `-` is a separator. |
| Checked | read/write | Shows a tick beside the item. Clicking doesn't change it: your code does (`f.mnuViewChart.Checked = not f.mnuViewChart.Checked`). |
| Enabled | read/write | False greys the item out. |
| Visible | read/write | False hides the item. |
| Shortcut | read/write | Key that chooses it: `Ctrl+O`, `Ctrl+Shift+S`, `F5`... |
| Phone | read/write | False leaves the item off the phone view's menu (chapter 16). |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| Click | Choose the item from code. |

**Events**

| Event procedure | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `Name_Click(f)` | The item is chosen, by mouse, access key or Shortcut. |

## Events every control can also send elsewhere

Any event of any control (and the form) can also, with no code:

- publish to an MQTT topic (`"publish"`, chapter 8),
- call an n8n webhook (`"webhook"`, chapter 10), which then fires
  `Name_WebhookResponse(f, data)` or `Name_WebhookError(f, message)`,
- be waited for by Claude (`wait_for_event`, chapter 11).

The form also fires `Form_MqttError(f, message)` when its MQTT link
(the form-level `mqtt` block) can't connect.
